title: The Three Houses: How Trauma Creates Empaths, Narcissists, and the Dark Ones in Between
author: Solfligh
description:
The same rain falls on every house. But what grows thorns or flowers depends on what you water.

Most books about narcissists and empaths make one mistake: they pretend only one side suffered. The truth is harder and more hopeful.

The Three Houses begins with a simple question: What if the empath and the narcissist were hurt by the same storm?

Using the unforgettable metaphor of two neighboring houses The Fortress (narcissist) and The Open Window (empath) this book walks you through nine chapters of insight, storytelling, and healing.

You will meet:

Kemi, the nurse who cries when her patients cry

James, the manager who yells at anyone who makes a mistake

And Marcus, the charming friend who seems to understand your pain then weaponizes it (The Dark Empath)

Each chapter offers not just understanding, but action. You will learn:

How to recognize if you are an empath, a narcissist, or something in between

Why boundaries are not cruelty they are kindness to yourself

Whether a narcissist can ever truly change

How to heal from trauma without becoming hard or hollow

Written for survivors, over-givers, and anyone who has ever asked, "Why do I feel everything?" or "Why do I feel nothing?" this book is a gentle, honest mirror.

You cannot choose your storm. But you can choose what you build after.
